question_text: Describe how you handle an employee who repeatedly misses deadlines.
expected_answer: You review expectations identify obstacles and create a plan for improvement

question_text: Explain how you address an employee who feels their workload is unfair.
expected_answer: You listen evaluate workload distribution and adjust responsibilities if needed

question_text: Describe how you help resolve a minor conflict between two employees.
expected_answer: You meet with both parties clarify concerns and guide them toward a mutual agreement

question_text: Explain how you respond when an employee reports confusion about a policy change.
expected_answer: You explain the change clearly provide examples and share updated documentation

question_text: Describe how you support an employee returning from extended leave.
expected_answer: You review their transition plan update them on changes and ensure they feel supported

question_text: Explain how you handle an employee who expresses dissatisfaction with their role.
expected_answer: You explore their concerns discuss career goals and identify possible adjustments

question_text: Describe how you respond when an employee requests additional training.
expected_answer: You evaluate the need approve relevant training and schedule the appropriate resources

question_text: Explain how you manage an employee who struggles with communication.
expected_answer: You provide feedback offer coaching and set clear expectations for improvement

question_text: Describe how you handle an employee who frequently arrives late.
expected_answer: You review attendance policy discuss reasons and set corrective steps

question_text: Explain how you support a team experiencing low morale.
expected_answer: You identify root causes encourage feedback and implement morale boosting actions
